pitch: Modular automated waste sorting & biomethanation units capable of processing 45 MT/day of MSW directly in Gandhinagar, raising recycling rate from 15 MT/day to 60+ MT/day.
Computer-vision AI signal controllers fitted to 25 of Bangalore's 353 traffic lights to dynamically adjust green lights based on real-time queue lengths.
IoT-monitored smart collection bins and dynamic route optimization for Gandhinagar's waste collection fleet to eliminate the 30 MT/day uncollected waste deficit.
Corridor-wide green wave synchronization for 12 adjacent intersections in Bangalore to slash peak wait times from 14.5 mins down to under 5 mins.
Low-power current monitoring sensors installed on traffic light control boxes across Bangalore's 353 intersections to alert maintenance teams in under 15 minutes of any signal outage.
